title: Shorten or remove topbar/hero subtitle: 'Guided, evidence-first assessment...' is too verbose for enterprise use
goal: The application shell (topbar or hero area depending on active screen) shows a long subtitle: 'Guided, evidence-first assessment operations across wizard-driven setup, live mission control, adaptive pack governance, evidence replay, and report delivery.' This is a marketing description that takes significant vertical space and repeats on every screen. For enterprise operators who use the tool daily, this is noise. Options in priority order: (1) Remove the subtitle entirely — the screen headings already describe each screen, (2) Keep a very short tagline (max 8 words, e.g. 'Penetration testing operations platform') only on the Dashboard/home screen, (3) Move to an About section in Settings. Do not add any new subtitle text that is as long as the current one.
scope: System review 2026-05-01: The hero subtitle 'Guided, evidence-first assessment operations across wizard-driven setup, live mission control, adaptive pack governance, evidence replay, and report delivery.' appears in the topbar or hero area across all screens.
